part.text: Fixed. In `MultiFieldQueryParser.getFieldQuery(field, queryText, slop)` (lucene/queryparser/src/java/org/apache/lucene/queryparser/classic/MultiFieldQueryParser.java:148), the configured field boost was applied before the slop, so `applySlop` received a `BoostQuery` wrapper rather than the underlying `PhraseQuery`/`MultiPhraseQuery` and silently dropped the slop. I swapped the order so slop is applied to the phrase query first, then the boost wraps it — matching the pre-5.4 behavior. All 12 `TestMultiFieldQueryParser` tests (including `testBoostsSimple` with slop) plus 83 related parser tests pass.
